summary: Braskem S.A. filed a 6-K announcing that a Brazilian court granted processing of its extrajudicial reorganization (a court-supervised out-of-court restructuring, the Brazilian equivalent of a pre-packaged Chapter 11). The filing details a 120-day stay on enforcement actions, lawsuits, and asset seizures against the company and certain subsidiaries by creditors subject to the plan, plus suspension of statutes of limitation. Braskem has 90 days to obtain creditor quorum for plan confirmation. No financial terms, advisor, or premium disclosed. Watch for plan confirmation, creditor negotiations, and potential equity dilution or debt-for-equity swap risk-arb angle.
